findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed no barrier to be used when hand washing. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper hand washing and hands were rewashed. Ensure a barrier is used when washing hands to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed cut tomatoes to be held past date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, tomatoes will be discarded. Ensure any TCS item is discarded after its 7 day date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) Observed an empty sanitizer bucket in the hand sink. The hand sink should not be blocked. Ensure staff is aware. Inspector moved the item. COS. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed multiple items in the cooler next to the fryer to not have date marking available. Discussed with PIC, said items were discarded. Ensure staff is date marking any TCS foods. 

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Observed multiple flies throughout the facility. Discussed with PIC, ensure kitchen is kept pest free and flies are no longer present. 

There is an air curtain fan present by the main service window that was not able to be turned on during inspection. Ensure repairs are made so equipment can be used to prevent unwanted pests. 

6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed the outside bottom edge and the floor of the walk in cooler to be rusting and in need of repair. Discussed with PIC, ensure equipment is smooth and easily cleanable. 

4-202.16: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no test strips for Quat sanitizer. Discussed with PIC, ensure facility has test strips available at all hours of operation. 

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no sani bucket present at beginning of the inspection. Sani bucket was empty and within the hand sink. Discussed with PIC, sani bucket was made upon request. One tablet was initially added to the bucket, however it only tested at 100 ppm so a second tablet was added. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas in need of cleaning:
1) The ceiling air vents have an accumulation of dust.
2) The flooring below and the wall behind the fryers have an accumulation of dirt, grease and food debris. 

Discussed with PIC, ensure facility is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents accumulation of dust, grease, and food debris. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.  

Observed limited active managerial control at the facility: cold holding temperatures were out, hot holding temperatures were out, hand sink was blocked, no test strips for sanitizer, in-use rags throughout the facility and not in sani buckets, no probe style thermometer to monitor food temperatures, etc. Ensure more oversight by the CFPM’s managers on site at the facility (cook was a verified food handler; however, there are CFPM’s throughout the grounds and more managerial control should be extended to the snack bar area). Inspector will follow-up on 6/26/23.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

(REPEAT) Observed the hand sink to be blocked by a cutting board and the heat lamp. Cease practice. The empty sani bucket was also in the hand sink. The hand sink should not be blocked. Ensure staff is aware. Inspector moved all the items. COS. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 6/29/22.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-202.12: (A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf (B) Steam mixing valve may not be used. (C) A self-closing, slow-closing, or metered faucet shall provide at least 15 seconds of flowing water. (D) An automatic sink shall be installed to manufacturer’s guidelines. 

Observed the hand sink hot water temperature to be low - not at least 100F. Inspector kept the sink on for ~ 5 minutes and the temperature never increased. Discussed with PIC. Ensure repairs by 6/26/23.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above. 

Observed all the steam table items (cheese sauce, burgers, red sauce) to be out of hot holding temperatures: ~115F. Inspector asked the cook to rapidly reheat the items to 165F. Cook complied. Ensure that temperatures remain 135F or above. Steam table temperature was increased. COS.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

(REPEAT) Observed the entire bottom of the prep cooler to be out of temperature. Probed items included: hot dogs (51F), deli ham (51F), grilled chicken (55F), turkey slices (52F). Items were discarded along with other items (brats, burgers, loose cut lettuce, chicken salad, tuna salad). Discussed with PIC. Air Masters was called and service is coming today, 6/16. All items were voluntarily discarded with the cook and Inspector throwing items away. Do not use the bottom prep cooler until it is keeping temperature and leave a hanging thermometer within the cooler. Top prep cooler was minding correct temperature. Surface temperature of sliced tomatoes was 45F. Inspector suggested keeping top prep cooler item on ice until cooler is serviced. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 6/29/22. Inspector will follow-up on 6/21/23.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

(REPEAT) Observed the bottom prep cooler to lack a thermometer. Discussed with PIC. Hanging thermometer was brought from main club house. COS. Ensure all cold holding units have hanging thermometers present. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 6/29/22.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-302.12: (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets. 

Observed no probe style thermometer for the facility. Discussed with PIC. PIC will order one. Inspector will follow-up on 6/26/23.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels. 

Observed multiple in-use rags throughout the kitchen. Cease practice. Ensure rags stay in sani buckets when not in use. Ensure staff are aware. Rags are to be in sanitizer solution when not being utilized. COS.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

Observed no sani bucket present at beginning of the inspection. Sani bucket was empty and within the hand sink. Sani bucket was made upon request - 400 ppm of quaternary ammonium. Ensure staff is aware to make sani buckets before food engagement and change as frequently as needed to keep correct concentration (200 to 400 ppm for quaternary ammonium). COS.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Observed no test strips for the quaternary ammonium. PIC obtained more test strips from the main country club kitchen. Discussed with PIC - ensure test strips are available at this facility. COS.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed the following non-food contact surfaces in need of cleaning:
1. Walk-in cooler fans have a layer of dust.
2. Chest freezer in the back (with fries, tots) has a layer of ice - defrost as needed to prevent build-up.

Discussed routine cleaning with PIC. Ensure before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Mop sink needs attached to the wall and caulked.
2. Men’s hand sink has moldy caulk - re-caulk the sink to the wall.
3. Women’s hand sink is beginning to come away from the sink and wall - re-caulk the sink.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Correct before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

On arrival, the hand sink in the prep are was covered by the heat lamp used for holding orders after they have been prepared. The lamp was moved during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Pink bacterial/moldy slime is observed on the deflector shield of the ice machine. PIC instructed to maintain the machine clean so as to protect the ready to eat (RTE) TCS food. The item was cleaned during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

Sliced tomatoes in the prep cooler are observed with internal temperatures between 52F-55F. Per the PIC, the tomatoes have been in there since yesterday. The tomatoes were discarded during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. 

On arrival, the prep cooler does not appear to have a thermometer in the top section where TCS foods are observed out of temperature (refer to violation #22). A thermometer was found on top of the cooler (in the open air of the facility), and moved into the cooler to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Pink slime was observed on the defector tray in the ice machine. It was cleaned during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
750-130(e) Package food shall not be stored in direct contact with water or undrained ice.

Observed the display freezer to have an accumulation of frost and ice. The ice has begun to accumulate on the packages of foods in the freezer. Discussed with the person in charge and instructed to clean off the ice often enough so as to prevent accumulation of ice on packaged foods.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above). During inspection, observed grilled chicken breasts and ham at 45 and 46 degrees respectively (probe thermometer used). Chef discarded items voluntarily during inspection.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed turkey deli meat in the prep cooler ~50F. The meat was discarded during the inspection. All cold holding units must hold at 41F or below.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no QUAT test strips for the facility. QUAT test strips must be provided.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
1) Observed a leak at the three compartment sink. 2) Observed a leak in the prep cooler. Repair both leaks.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed an absence of drain covers in the kitchen (soda machine, sink and women's restroom) Replace drain covers.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed cheese, tomatoes, tuna salad, chicken, chicken salad, turkey and ham deli meat to be 53 - 56 F in the prep cooler (probe). All items were discarded during the inspection.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed two units to have no thermometers. Thermometers were placed in the cooler during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 750.150(a) All hot units that contain potentially hazardous foods shall contain  a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no QUAT test strips for the facility. QUAT test strips were provided during the inspection. Keep test kit in a dry place at all times.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed wet wiping cloths on counter tops during the inspection. Wet wiping cloths need to be stored in a sanitizer solution at all times to ensure proper sanitation between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the microwave (inside) to be soiled. The inside was cleaned during the inspection.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak at the three compartment sink.  Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no soap and paper towels at the handsink. Provide soap and paper towels to wash hands as needed.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed remalade sauce to have the date of 7/1/14.  The sauce was discarded.  Potentially hazardous foods are to be used or discarded within seven days.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the chest freezer with heavy ice buildup.  The freezer needs defrosted to make it a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed wet wiping cloths on counter tops during the inspection.  Wet wiping cloths need to be stored in a sanitizer solution at all times to ensure proper sanitation between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed duct tape on the top part of the chest freezer. Duct tape is not an easily cleanable surface and needs to be removed.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Observed many flies in the facility.  Employee had stated that the problem started today and sprayed the building.  Fan guards need to be installed to prevent pests from entering the building.  
Provide fan guards for areas where serving windows will be opened to serve the public.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Absence of sanitizer available for use in wiping cloth buckets and in 3 part sink where dishes are washed.  A spray bottle labeled "sanitizer" was present, but when tested, it was negative for Quat and too strong for Chlorine.  Bleach was available by the end of inspection.
750-830 All chemical sanitizers in a dish machine must meet the requirements of 21 CFR 178.1010 to ensure all items are properly sanitized.  Rinse water shall not less than 75F. Provide proper sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Absence of a sanitizer bucket available for wet/damp wiping cloths.  Keep damp wiping cloths in sanitizer in between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed some mold and calcium/lime build-up on the top, metal piece inside of ice machine.  Clean and sanitize this area of the ice machine.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak at the hand sink faucet and when the hot water handle was turned, water came out of the handle.  Repair leaks at this sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed a hole in the coving/baseboard in back area of kitchen by the walk-in cooler.  Fill the hole in this coving to prevent pests and so that it is smooth and easily cleanable.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed the plasticware to be stored improperly with the handles going in different directions.  Handles shall be all in the same direction to avoid contamination of the food surface when picking up the utensil.  The plasticware was stored correctly during inspection.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.
